Fix round. Inherited protection is judged by one read of the containers for a pass. When any container cannot be read, every image and network that pass would judge is refused, including one that another, readable container protects; the build listed such an object as protected. Both are safe: a refused object gets no record and its listing is left as it was.

Fix round. A network or image whose protected container is found later is listed as protected from that container's event on. A report written before is withdrawn; an item a run already owns keeps its record and defers at rule 2, as the build's assumption on objects recorded before protection says.
